_comment: The self-hosted basemap. Absence of this file, or an empty url, disables every map surface's tile layer and leaves the drawn SVG in place — a supported state, not a broken one.
_size: 116 MB. Covers Chiang Mai + Chiang Rai provinces whole, z0-15. The planet build's own max zoom is 15, so 15 is everything there is — MapLibre overzooms past it from z15 data rather than fetching more.
_hosting: TOO BIG FOR THE REPO: GitHub rejects files over 100 MB. This must live in R2 (or any host doing HTTP range requests) and the url below must point there before deploy. The relative path is for local verification only.
_enable: Live. Served from the same R2 bucket as the site, via publish/worker.js, which passes Range requests straight through to R2 — pmtiles is nothing but ranged reads. Set url to "" to switch the basemap off everywhere; every map falls back to its drawn SVG.
